plain_text:
Orson Welles appears in 150 recordings across 8 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1936 to 1953. The credits here include performer, narrator, host, writer, radio adaptor, and director.

In this archive, you will hear Orson Welles most often in The Lives of Harry Lime, The Shadow, The Black Museum, The Mercury Theatre on the Air, Columbia Workshop, Lux Radio Theatre, The Fred Allen Show, and Theatre Royal.

Characters credited here include Harry Lime and Lamont Cranston / The Shadow.
